reports.title: Palantir Reports Q3 2026 U.S. Comm Revenue Growth of 148% Y/Y and Revenue Growth of 96% Y/Y; Raises FY 2026 Revenue Guidance to 91% Y/Y Growth and U.S. Comm Revenue Guidance to 143% Y/Y, Crushing Consensus Expectations

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: •Adjusted income from operations of between $1.640 - $1.644 billion.

desk.headline: Revenue up 96% to $2.31bn, beat; full-year 2026 guidance raised again, above estimates
results: Revenue almost doubled (+96%) to $2.31bn, the first quarter above $2bn; US revenue rose 119% to $1.94bn.
US commercial sales grew 148% to $984m and, for the first time, overtook US government sales ($953m, +96%).
Profits jumped: GAAP net income of $1.13bn (49% margin) and adjusted operating income of $1.43bn (62% margin).
Closed $2.92bn of contract value (+6%), including 64 deals of at least $10m; US commercial remaining deal value $6.5bn (+79%).
Cash and US Treasuries reached $10.4bn; adjusted free cash flow was $1.22bn.

guidance.summary: Palantir raised its 2026 targets again: revenue now $8.530–8.534bn (about 91% growth) and US commercial revenue above $3.559bn. Q4 revenue is guided to $2.649–2.653bn, well above estimates.

points: CEO Alex Karp framed demand around 'Sovereign AI', saying institutions are splitting into haves and have-nots.
Karp highlighted 29% quarter-on-quarter growth in US commercial revenue and record quarterly profit.
As reported, Karp said Palantir aims for the whole market for defence AI software, not just a share of it.
The CFO said the guidance raise lifts expected 2026 growth from 82% to 91%; no 2027 outlook was given.
call.source: Press release (Exhibit 99.1) plus XTB, 2 Nov 2026 and FourWeekMBA, 2 Nov 2026 (call remarks secondhand)

watch: Whether US commercial growth holds near 150% as the base gets bigger.
Contract value grew only 6%; watch bookings against very fast revenue growth.
First 2027 outlook, expected with Q4 results.
